title: Degradation of rhodamine B using a heterogeneous Fenton-like reaction driven by nano-zero-valent iron loaded on biochar prepared in the presence of ultrasonic irradiation

The nZVI particles were corroded to generate Fe2+, and catalyzed H2O2 to produce ˙OH, the generated Fe3+ was reduced back to Fe2+ by nZVI. Furthermore, the Fe2+ could react with dissolved O2 to produce ˙O2−.
